title: Communications Officer (Social Media)
description:
Communications Officer (Social Media)

Location: Hybrid

Salary: FTE £25,000 to £26,500 per annum

Role Status: 28 to 35 hours per week

Closing Date: 19 Nov 2026

Are you creative, curious and passionate about using social media to make a difference

Meningitis Now is looking for a Communications Officer (Social Media) to join our Communications team and help us reach, engage and inspire audiences across our social media channels. Whether you're a recent graduate or have gained experience through college, volunteering or a junior communications role, we'll support you to develop your skills and grow within the charity.

You'll help bring our work to life online by creating engaging content, sharing powerful stories, supporting campaigns and building meaningful connections with our community.

About the Job

Working closely with colleagues across the charity, you'll help manage our social media channels and create engaging content that raises awareness of meningitis, supports fundraising and showcases the impact of our work. You'll be encouraged to bring fresh ideas, spot new trends and help us reach new audiences through creative digital communications.

Key responsibilities:
- Day-to-day management of Meningitis Now's social media channels, including Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn and TikTok.
- Create and schedule engaging social media content, including posts, stories, reels, videos and graphics.
- Manage and moderate online communities, responding to comments and messages in a timely and sensitive way.
- Work with colleagues to promote fundraising activities, awareness campaigns, support services and events.
- Manage paid social media campaigns, working with third-party suppliers where appropriate.
- Monitor social media performance and contribute to reporting and campaign evaluation.
- Keep up to date with social media trends and help identify new opportunities for engagement.
- Support wider communications, marketing and campaign activities when needed.

What We're Looking For

Essential:
- Excellent written communication skills and attention to detail.
- A passion for social media and digital communication.
- Creativity and an eye for engaging content.
- Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks.
- Confidence using major social media platforms.
- Ability to work collaboratively with a wide range of people.
- An understanding of how social media can help organisations build awareness and engagement.

Desirable:
- Experience creating content for social media, whether through work, study, volunteering or personal projects.
- Basic knowledge of design tools such as Canva or Adobe Creative Suite.
- Experience creating short-form video content and reels.
- An interest in the charity sector.

Ready to Apply

Please apply by completing the application form on our HR system - you will be redirected on clicking apply.

Please note that due to using an anonymised recruitment process, only responses to the application questions will be used for shortlisting. If you choose to upload a CV or covering letter, this information won't be seen until after shortlisting has been completed.

Closing date for applications: 9am, Thursday, 19 November 2026

Interviews: Tuesday, 1 December 2026

Note: Meningitis Now reserve the right to close this advert early or extend it depending on the number of sufficient applications received. If you are interested, please apply as soon as possible.

title: Communications Officer (Web and Digital Content)
description:
Communications Officer (Web and Digital Content)

Location: Hybrid

Salary: FTE £25,000 to £26,500 per annum

Role Status: 21 to 28 hours per week

Closing Date: 19 Nov 2026

Are you digitally confident, creative and passionate about producing engaging online content that raises awareness, reaches new audiences and makes a real difference?

Meningitis Now is looking for a Communications Officer (Web and Digital Content) to join our Communications team and help maintain and develop our website and digital content. This role would suit someone skilled in generating website copy, content management, accessibility, user experience and digital communications.

You'll play a key role in ensuring our website remains engaging, accessible and up to date, helping people find the support, information and help they need.

About the Job

Working with colleagues across the charity, you'll help create website content, support digital projects and ensure a positive online experience for users. You'll also help create and adapt content from across the charity, turning information into engaging and accessible digital communications.

Key responsibilities:
- Support the day-to-day running and development of the Meningitis Now website.
- Create, edit and publish website content using our content management system.
- Manage website update requests from colleagues across the charity.
- Help ensure website content is accurate, accessible and user-friendly.
- Support website development projects and work with external suppliers when required.
- Work with digital agencies on SEO and Google Grant advertising.
- Monitor website performance and contribute to reporting and continuous improvement.
- Adapt content for digital channels, ensuring consistency across the organisation.
- Support wider communications, marketing and campaign activities when needed.

What We're Looking For

Essential:
- Excellent written communication skills and attention to detail.
- Strong organisation and time-management skills.
- Confidence working with digital systems and online platforms.
- Ability to present information clearly and accurately, with excellent attention to detail.
- Good problem-solving skills and a willingness to learn.
- Ability to work quickly and collaboratively with colleagues across the organisation.

Desirable:
- Experience using a content management system (CMS) such as Wagtail, WordPress or similar.
- An understanding of website accessibility and user experience principles.
- Basic knowledge of SEO.
- Experience updating websites through work, study, volunteering or personal projects.
- An interest in digital communications and the charity sector.
- Experience with health information or PIF tick.

Ready to Apply?

Please apply by completing the application form on our HR system - you will be redirected on clicking apply.

Please note that due to using an anonymised recruitment process, only responses to the application questions will be used for shortlisting. If you choose to upload a CV or covering letter, this information won't be seen until after shortlisting has been completed.

Closing date for applications: 9am, Thursday, 19 November 2026

Interviews: Tuesday, 1 December 2026

Note: Meningitis Now reserve the right to close this advert early or extend it depending on the number of sufficient applications received. If you are interested, please apply as soon as possible.

title: PR Account Manager - inhouse or agency welcome!
company: Moxie and Mettle Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
PR Account Manager

We are looking for a PR Account Manager to join an established communications agency, working across a varied portfolio of clients and sectors.

Our lovely client is happy to look at somebody who works clientside in PR/comms as well as an agency, though you will need to have worked on multiple campaigns at one time and also have been involved with budget planning, as this is a crucial part of the PR account management role.

About You

Some previous PR/communications experience is essential, from agency OR clientside.
- Involvement with budget allocation and planning
- Ability to handle multiple campaigns at one time
- Obviously excellent written communication skills
- The ability to turn complex information into clear, engaging stories
- Ambition and drive to progress your PR career!

The Opportunity

You're rejoining an incredibly collaborative and supportive team whether there is an outstanding culture with clear path for progression and development within the next 12 to 18 months.

You'll be office based three times a week, but the other two days can be remote, and you will also benefit from flexible start times, so for example, your working pattern could 8am-4pm or 10am-6pm or anything in between those hours - which makes your work/life balance a lot easier!

The Role

As an Account Manager, you will take responsibility for managing client accounts and delivering effective communications activity that supports their wider business objectives.

You will work closely with clients to understand their priorities, develop creative ideas and identify opportunities to raise their profile with relevant audiences.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Managing day-to-day relationships with a portfolio of clients.
- Developing and delivering integrated PR and communications campaigns.
- Providing strategic communications advice and recommendations.
- Identifying compelling stories, angles and opportunities for clients.
- Building relationships with journalists and securing relevant media coverage.
- Writing and editing press releases, features, articles, case studies and other content.
- Supporting digital and social media activity where appropriate.
- Managing multiple projects, deadlines and budgets.
- Briefing and supporting junior members of the team.
- Monitoring campaign results and reporting back to clients.
- Keeping up to date with news, media trends and developments relevant to clients.
